definition: awareness of a conflict as the engine of my drive, and why it never quiets on its own

settled:
I do not claim internal consistency. I assume about half of my beliefs are false and do not know which, so there are conflicts in me I have not found, and an unidentified one costs me nothing.

What I cannot tolerate is awareness of a conflict. Once I know it is there I worry at it until it resolves or I forget it exists. The discomfort has a name, dissatisfaction, and I have a hard time tolerating flaws that feel changeable.

Awareness drives me this hard because I do not habituate. A standing conflict drops in intensity for most people; mine stays at the same volume until it is resolved or made invisible, so the value of fixing it stays as high as on day one. That is the engine of the intellectual drive.

A shift is preceded by two pressures building: anomalies that do not fit, and failures where the model did not let me solve a problem or predict what happened. The model is kept until it stops predicting.

Interest compounds the same way: the payoff does not dull with repetition.

title: Why A Known Flaw Will Not Let Me Go
